outro_summary: Tommy uses information to get a hearing, then turns a threatened takeover into a thirty-five-percent deal. Later, he treats another betrayal as a moral exception. Alfie forces him to face the standard they share. The final clarification about the child matters: their argument ends with a conceded point, not a new friendship.
